Use case: illustration-story. Production asset: ONE 49ERS football cover atlas for Sunday Arcade. EXACTLY one column and three equal-height rows, three independent full-bleed landscape panels stacked vertically, no gutters. Overall portrait image, ideally 1536x2880, each panel wide landscape. Input 1 is character identity/style reference ONLY, use ROW 3 of its four-row cast sheet. Redraw the entire bodies into NEW anatomically credible poses; never paste or reuse the reference stances. Featured cast, in panel order: Christian McCaffrey #23, Brock Purdy #13, Eddy Pineiro #18. Faithful 49ers uniforms, faces and hair. Opponents wear seahawks uniforms, distinct from home players.
STYLE LOCK (HIGHEST PRIORITY): Use the attached ORIGINAL SPRITE SHEET as the ONLY style and character reference. These must be the SAME chunky 3D CARTOON arcade characters redrawn in new football positions, not realistic athletes. Preserve their big expressive heads, short stocky powerful bodies, broad exaggerated shoulders, chunky hands and boots, simplified smooth sculpted skin, stylized hair, collectible videogame materials, original team accessories and readable jersey numbers. No change to realistic human proportions. All supporting players must share the same chunky head/body proportions. Turf, crowd and stadium must also be a detailed stylized 3D CARTOON videogame environment, coherent with the sprites. DO NOT use photography, photoreal textures, realistic human figures, painted sports editorial illustration, comic-book crosshatching or flat vectors. Entire scene looks like a polished screenshot of the original sprite characters' arcade game. Integrated 3D cartoon lighting, materials and shadows. Redraw whole bodies and their poses with AI, never paste old sprite poses.
Camera: ALL scenes elevated sideline, looking diagonally DOWN at 35-45 degrees, field extends sideways, yard lines cross at an angle. Different camera position, background, field location, lighting and arrangement in EACH panel. 7-10 distinct full-body athletes engaged in a real play, no frontal portrait lineup. Feature player naturally belongs in the play, same anatomical scale as nearby teammates. Keep important action within central 80% for thumbnail crop, legs/feet attached, plausible balanced weight, arms really reach opponents. Helmeted supporting athletes, featured face visible through open facemask or without helmet matching reference.
TOP panel, TOUCHDOWN RUSH: Christian McCaffrey #23 carrying ONE tucked football, cutting sideways diagonally at the 20 toward open space; outside foot plants and hips turn; one defender dives and reaches at hips, another pursues at full sprint; home blocker leans into an opponent with hands on chest, another teammate leads into the lane. Environment: open red-gold sideline stands and distant low green hills; afternoon. Home end-zone corner may appear in distance.
MIDDLE panel, PASSING DRIVE: Brock Purdy #13 in a pocket, opposite foot planted downfield, back leg drives, torso rotating into overarm release; ONE ball still at raised throwing hand; linemen in wide staggered stances actively hand-fighting rushers, one rusher dipping shoulder around edge, downfield receiver accelerating into a break and corner turning to follow. Environment: midfield facing stacked glass hospitality boxes, red field paint; evening. Midfield, no end zone, completely different background from other panels.
BOTTOM panel, FIELD GOALS: Eddy Pineiro #18 at ball strike/follow-through, plant foot beside holder, kicking leg swings naturally toward uprights; holder kneeling with ONE knee down, other foot planted and hands withdrawing from spot; protection line faces incoming rush, blockers lean with bent knees, one defender jumps vertically arms raised. One football just airborne toward yellow goalposts at upper diagonal side. Environment: red end-zone tunnel and opposite lower bowl; pale overcast. Near goal line, no midfield, different view/background again.
Constraints: three exact equal-height panels, full bleed with no labels, no title text, no watermark. Each panel has its own natural complete composition. No duplicate player faces, duplicated jersey numbers on same side, same crouch on everybody, tiny toy teammates, floating feet, pasted face cutouts, detached joints, extra hands, extra footballs, glowing trails, arbitrary arrows or diagram overlays.
LAYOUT CRITICAL: THREE WIDE 16:10 LANDSCAPE PANELS, equal heights, one column stacked, overall portrait 1:1.875 (width/height 0.5333). All 3 complete football plays must keep the source SPRITE STYLE, big heads and short chunky cartoon proportions. This is not a real-world sports illustration or photo. No additional reference images should override the original sprite art style.
Input 2 is the STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCE ONLY: match its exact chunky 3D cartoon sprite proportions, faces/material finish and cohesive cartoon environments, plus three landscape rows. Do not copy its Eagles uniforms, backgrounds or identities. Use your own requested team from the specified row of input 1. Faithfully match the original sprites' cartoon look; no realistic human render.
